strategies.subtitle: Side-by-side comparison of allocation algorithms under identical conditions
strategies.proportionalRule: Shares available power equally based on sector demand
strategies.essentialFirstRule: Prioritizes critical health clinic & water pumping first
strategies.balancedRule: Guarantees critical baseline and applies weighted sharing for remaining energy
